description: Rank the tools people actually use for one use case, by number of community mentions in a dated window, with what users praise and complain about. Use for 'what's the best AI code review tool according to users', 'what do people use for mobile apps'. Input: `slug` from list_scenarios; `limit`. Returns per tool: id, mention count, main strengths and weak spots (M = most mentions, S = some), the date window and last update date. Say the window when quoting.
name: scenario
title: Scenario ranking
